assumptions: Rates are the published standard-harness Copilot Credit rate card captured 2026-08-13 from the source_url.
Employee-facing (B2E) usage by a Microsoft 365 Copilot-licensed user is 'No charge' against these meters; this profile prices the B2B / unlicensed path so the benchmark reports a non-zero cost lane.

Bring-your-own-model (Azure Foundry) token usage is billed separately and is NOT represented here; for Pattern B and the Hosted front door, add the Foundry per-token USD lane on top of the connected-agent action credits.
Credits are a per-message unit and never convert to tokens or USD; do not add Credits to the Foundry USD lane.
One benchmarked question maps to one user message; multi-turn or retry inflation is not modeled.
agent_action counts are marked uncertain because Copilot Studio does not expose a per-message billable-event breakdown over Direct Line; confirm against the admin-center consumption grid.
Patterns whose Copilot Studio agent is currently non-responsive (B, Hosted front doors) have no live message evidence; their estimate is configuration-only until the agents are fixed.
